# services/checkout/config.yaml — generated by platform-config v3, do not hand-edit sections marked [managed]
service:
  name: checkout
  tier: critical
  owner: payments-platform
  region_failover: eu-central-1 -> eu-west-1

server:
  listeners:
    - name: public-https
      port: 8443
      protocol: h2
      idle_timeout_s: 75
    - name: internal-grpc
      port: 9090
      protocol: grpc
      idle_timeout_s: 300
  max_concurrent_streams: 512
  drain_grace_s: 30

connection_pool:
  db:
    max_open: 120
    max_idle: 24
    max_lifetime_m: 30
    acquire_timeout_ms: 900
  redis:
    max_open: 200
    max_idle: 40
    acquire_timeout_ms: 250

timeouts:
  upstream_default_ms: 2500
  payment_provider_ms: 8000
  fraud_check_ms: 1200
  inventory_hold_ms: 1800

retry_policy:
  max_retries: 3
  backoff_base_ms: 120
  backoff_multiplier: 2.0
  backoff_jitter: full
  retry_on: [connect-failure, refused-stream, 502, 503, 504]
  budget_pct: 20

circuit_breaker:
  breaker_threshold_5xx: 0.35
  breaker_window_s: 60
  min_requests: 40
  half_open_probes: 5
  cooldown_s: 45

rate_limits:
  public_rps: 1800
  per_customer_rps: 40
  burst_multiplier: 1.5
  shed_strategy: adaptive-lifo

queues:
  capture_worker:
    concurrency: 32
    max_in_flight: 4096
    visibility_timeout_s: 120
    dead_letter_after: 6
  refund_worker:
    concurrency: 8
    max_in_flight: 512
    visibility_timeout_s: 300
    dead_letter_after: 4

cache:
  catalog_ttl_s: 900
  price_ttl_s: 120
  negative_ttl_s: 15
  stampede_protection: request-coalescing

telemetry:  # [managed]
  traces_sample_rate: 0.08
  slow_span_threshold_ms: 400
  red_metrics_interval_s: 15
  high_cardinality_labels: false

security:  # [managed]
  tls_min_version: "1.3"
  hsts_max_age_d: 180
  idempotency_key_header: X-Idempotency-Key
  idempotency_ttl_h: 24

feature_flags:
  split_capture_refund_pools: true
  provider_failover_v2: true
  soft_decline_retry: false
  checkout_express_lane: canary-only

deploys:
  strategy: canary
  canary_steps_pct: [5, 25, 50, 100]
  bake_time_m: 30
  auto_rollback_on: [p99_regression, error_budget_burn]
